definitions: To succumb to sleep due to extreme tiredness.
To lose consciousness or drift into sleep because of overwhelming fatigue.
examples: After working for 18 hours straight, she was bound to fall asleep or pass out from exhaustion.
He warned them not to overexert themselves, or they would fall asleep or pass out from exhaustion.
lemma: to fall asleep or pass out from exhaustion
pastTenses: fell asleep or passed out from exhaustion, fallen asleep or passed out from exhaustion
source: to fall asleep or pass out from exhaustion
